# TPC-Havoc Q3_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    l_orderkey,
    sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue,
    o_orderdate,
    o_shippriority
from
    orders,
    lineitem
where
    l_orderkey = o_orderkey
    and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-15'
    and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-15'
    and exists (
        select 1
        from customer
        where c_custkey = o_custkey
          and c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
    )
group by
    l_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_shippriority
order by
    revenue desc,
    o_orderdate
```
